name: Example accounts-payable controls
source: Illustrative. Replace with the customer's own controls, reviewed by a person before compiling.

controls.name: Payments above USD 50,000 require CFO approval
No more than USD 100,000 leaves in one day
A change to a vendor's bank details is verified by callback, and payments hold for 30 days after one
Only vendors in the vendor master are paid, at the account on file
